rolled_up_meta_summary: Patch 1.9.32 favors high-mobility assassins and sustain fighters in Jungle/EXP, paired with teamfight-controlling Roamers and scaling Gold-lane marksmen. Anti-heal (Sea Halberd, Glowing Wand, Dominance Ice) and anti-dive tools (Winter Crown, Wind of Nature, Khufra/Diggie) are high priority in Mythic+ drafts.

heroes.name: Terizla
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Sustain and early lane pressure remain top-tier; slight cooldown adjustment on Penalty Zone keeps him a premier teamfight EXP laner.

heroes.name: Arlott
heroes.recent_patch_summary: High dash reset threat when paired with ally CC; vulnerable to Purify and anti-dash zones.

heroes.name: Yu Zhong
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Backline dive with Black Dragon Form excels against immobile mages and marksmen; slowed by early anti-heal.

heroes.name: Benedetta
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Strong split-push and backline access via Alecto: Final Blow; punished by Phoveus/Khufra anti-dash.

heroes.name: Edith
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Flexible frontline-to-ranged magic DPS; thrives into dive compositions that feed her Wrath meter.

heroes.name: Ling
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Top Mythic+ ban/pick; wall mobility and Tempest of Blades invulnerability dominate once 2 core crit/attack items are online.

heroes.name: Fanny
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Extreme early snowball and map pressure; heavily reliant on Purple Buff and countered by hard suppress or Khufra.

heroes.name: Hayabusa
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Reliable single-target assassination with Ougi: Shadow Kill; Winter Crown and clustered allies reduce his ult value.

heroes.name: Suyou
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Dual-form tap/hold skills give unmatched early skirmish damage reduction and objective secure.

heroes.name: Fredrinn
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Durable utility jungler who anchors Lord fights and sets up burst mages with taunt chains.

heroes.name: Julian
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Level 3 power spike enables aggressive early invades and flexible magic-damage drafting.

heroes.name: Valentina
heroes.recent_patch_summary: I Am You scales directly with enemy high-impact ultimates like Tigreal, Minotaur, and Luo Yi.

heroes.name: Zhuxin
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Sustained Lantern Flare displacement punishes low-mobility frontliners and controls river chokepoints.

heroes.name: Luo Yi
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Yin-Yang Reaction punishes clumped teams; Diversion enables coordinated 5-man Lord and side-lane flanks.

heroes.name: Vexana
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Consistent wave clear, anti-dive terrify, and Undead Knight frontline presence.

heroes.name: Lunox
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Shreds high-HP tank jungles and fighters with Chaos Assault %HP magic damage.

heroes.name: Moskov
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Global Spear of Destruction teleport threat plus high attack-speed wall-stun outplay potential.

heroes.name: Harith
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Premier Gold-lane magic carry; Zaman Force shields and dashes shred teams lacking hard lockdown or Esmeralda/anti-shield.

heroes.name: Claude
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Safe laning with Battle Mirror Image and high teamfight AoE with Demon Hunter Sword + Golden Staff.

heroes.name: Beatrix
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Versatile wave-clear and siege with Renner/Wesker/Bennett; strong lane bully into short-range carries.

heroes.name: Brody
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Dominant early Gold-lane trades and self-peel stun; transitions well into hybrid tank-item builds.

heroes.name: Tigreal
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Flicker + Implosion remains a premier engage combo; countered by Diggie's Time Journey and Purify.

heroes.name: Mathilda
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Guiding Wind free dash enables immobile carries and accelerates early Jungle rotations.

heroes.name: Angela
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Heartguard global shield + speed amplifies dive assassins (Ling, Suyou, Fanny) in mid-game skirmishes.

heroes.name: Minotaur
heroes.recent_patch_summary: AoE knockup + teamwide heal with Flask of the Oasis; strong frontline anchor for scaling marksmen.

heroes.name: Khufra
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Bouncing Ball hard-stops dash-heavy meta threats (Fanny, Ling, Benedetta, Arlott, Harith).

heroes.name: Diggie
heroes.recent_patch_summary: Time Journey completely negates hard-engage tank setups like Tigreal and Minotaur.

hero_relationships.explanation: Khufra's Bouncing Ball interrupts Fanny's Steel Cable mid-flight, shutting down her dive and escape.
Khufra blocks Ling's Finch Poise and Defiant Sword dashes during teamfights.
Bouncing Ball grounds Benedetta's passive dash and punishes her commitment.
Khufra interrupts Harith's Chrono Dash resets inside Zaman Force.
Diggie's Time Journey cleanses Tigreal's Implosion + Sacred Hammer combo for the entire team.
Time Journey grants CC immunity against Minotaur's Minoan Fury knockups.
Diggie denies Arlott's Final Slash setup and prevents Vengeance mark chains.
Valentina steals Tigreal's Implosion for a high-value counter-engage.
Valentina copies Luo Yi's Diversion to match macro map rotations.
Lunox's Chaos Assault %HP magic damage melts high-HP Fredrinn frontlines.
Zhuxin kites and displaces low-mobility Terizla before he can land Penalty Zone.
Hayabusa threatens isolated Moskov split-pushes with Quad Shadow + Shadow Kill.
Ling bypasses frontline walls to burst immobile Beatrix in backline.
Edith's chain CC and Primal Wrath burst punish Suyou when he dives into melee range.
Fanny loses cable momentum and gets locked down by Khufra's Bouncing Ball.
Tigreal's engage is neutralized whenever Diggie holds Time Journey.
Ling struggles to dash cleanly through teamfights when Khufra guards carries.
Terizla gets repeatedly lifted and kited by Zhuxin's Lantern Flare.
Angela's Heartguard shield and movement speed turn Ling's backline dive into an unkillable wipe.
Heartguard sustains Suyou through early-to-mid skirmishes and tower dives.
Mathilda's Guiding Wind gives Terizla free gap-close for Penalty Zone without burning Flicker.
Mathilda + Harith create relentless high-tempo skirmish pressure from level 4.
Tigreal's AoE displacement applies marks across multiple enemies for Arlott's Vengeance dash resets.
Tigreal groups enemies tightly for Luo Yi's Yin-Yang Reaction burst.
Minotaur's heal, attack-speed buff, and peel protect Claude during Blazing Duet.
Fredrinn's frontline lockdown holds targets in place for Lunox's Chaos Assault DPS.
